doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: Brass bands, funerals and Mardi Gras
summary: He lists brass bands he worked with, including DeJalma Gagne's, for funerals and Mardi Gras.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: What about, let's see. Who are some of the other bands you played with?
Oh, I played with two, three brass bands off and on like that. But Donnie D. the trumpet player, you know.
Well, who are some of them? Well, I think DeRica. I worked with him a while. I believe. What about DeJalma Gagne?
Yeah, I worked with Gagne. How often did you play with him? Well, whenever we'd get a funeral parade, they'd get them quite often.
Well, Mardi Gras, too. I started my Mardi Gras playing with me with Dianne. Mm-hmm. See, I joined his band. Of course, Mardi Gras parade. That's been his back then. I was in my Mardi Gras.
